_doc: The wording of routes this organization retired, read by scripts/check-retired.mjs in every guide. When a decision retires a route (source/decisions.md), the same change sweeps the guides and adds the old wording here. pattern: the instruction, case-insensitive. unless: a line that mentions it as history. say: what the guide should say instead. allow: files that quote it on purpose. Example: { "id": "drafts-in-shared-drive", "since": "2026-11-02", "decision": "source/decisions.md 2026-11-02", "pattern": "drafts? (?:live|go) in the shared drive", "unless": "until 2026-|used to", "say": "drafts are files in the repo; the drive only receives what is sent" }
